text: giant rat
This appears to be a mutant rat, grown to dog's size by some unknown
force. Its beady red eyes peer at you along the length of its dirty
muzzle, and it flicks its hairless pink tail nervously. The giant rat
has sharp, yellow teeth that could inflict sizeable wounds.
lashworm
This is an ugly, mottled gray worm, about three feet in length. It
appears to be eyeless, and weaves its head about in the air as if
searching for something. This hideous beast has a mouth full of
extremely sharp teeth, and is known to strike with lightning speed.
filthbug
The filthbug is a two foot long beetle-like creature. It has a black
and brown spotted shell, and long spindly legs with small claws on
the ends. The filthbug is known to be a scavenger, and though it does
not pose much of a threat, its shell makes it tough to kill.
ill.
carrion beast
This creature is an obvious mutation: it is the size of a small dog,
and is furred, but has six jointed legs and a snout bristling with
gnarled fangs. The carrion beast is known to be a berserker when
disturbed, and can be tough to kill.
acid slime
This is a small bluish glob of protoplasm, a product of strange
magical mutations. It moves quite slowly, and is fairly easy to hit
as it does not dodge, but it can deal serious and painful wounds with
its pseudopods.
orc rogue
With its squinting narrow eyes, sharp pointed teeth, and harsh,
callous demeanor, the figure before you could only be an orc. It is
wearing rigid leather armour, and carries a readied short sword. It
looks around furtively, as if searching for trouble.
kobold thief
The creature before you stands about four feet tall, has small pointy
teeth, and is garbed in mismatched armour. It carries a short sword,
and flicks its eyes around nervously as it sneaks about.
cave worm
This long, grey worm is about one foot in diameter, with pale
gelatinous eyes and a maw full of three inch long needle-sharp teeth.
It weaves about as if searching for prey. Cave worms are quite tough,
and when they hit inflict horrible jagged wounds.
thug
This thug creeps around stealthily, looking for some unsuspecting
person to ambush and rob. He wears leather armour, and wields a nasty
looking spiked club.
skeleton
The animated skeleton of a humanoid creature stands before you. Bits
of dried flesh cling to its yellow bones, and faint flickers of red
light can be seen in its eye sockets. The undead are known to be very
difficult to destroy, as they are already dead.
zombie
This is an animated, rotting corpse. It walks around listlessly, and
its eyeless face gives no hint of emotion. The necromantic magic that
has animated this creation has made it quite tough to slay, and it is
imbued with an unnatural strength.
small golem
This is a four foot tall grey golem, apparently made of some sort of
hardened clay. It is slow and somewhat clumsy, and its sole purpose
is to be a target in the arena for the purpose of training combat
skills.
guardsman
This is a fierce-looking guardsman. He wields a drawn broadsword and
carries a round shield, and his well-polished chainmail armour gleams
in the light. Guardsmen are known to be excellent fighters, and are
more than a match for most lesser adversaries.
shade
This is a shadowy spirit in the vague shape of a human, with glowing
red points of light where its eyes should be. It is hard to see, and
seems to fade in and out of existance.
ghoul
This awful-looking creature appears to be a filthy, emaciated human -
until you see its glowing red eyes and sharp claws. Its frail
appearance belies powerful muscles, and it moves with surprising
grace.
wight
This revolting undead creation is a bent, misshapen humanoid with
glowing red points for eyes, and cruelly-hooked claws. Despite its
gaunt appearance, you can see it is powerfully muscled, and moves
with the confident speed of a cat.
orc sentry
This leather-clad warrior has the unmistakeable features of an orc.
It wields a wickedly sharp scimitar, and stands with uncharacteristic
discipline for its race.
orc lieutenant
This tall, ferocious-looking orc wears chainmail and wields a razor-
sharp scimitar, a sure sign of high rank. He is disciplined and holds
himself in such a manner as to indicate that he knows how to use his
weapon skilfully.
mercenary
This leather-clad warrior has a decidedly shifty appearance. The
readied longsword he carries is notched and looks as if it has seen
much use. These mercenaries are sometimes nothing more than hired
thugs, and this particular one seems to fit right into that category.
half-ogre bodyguard
This huge warrior is unmistakeably a half-ogre, as his 7 foot tall
frame clearly shows. He looks strong enough to snap a human in two.
He is clad in leather armour and wields a massive hammer.
Aiken
This bored-looking young man is apparently some sort of magician's
apprentice, if his robes and demeanor are anything to go by. He is
plain-looking, but is decently built, and has a gleam of intelligence
in his eye.
Thuluk
Before you stands a powerfully-muscled dwarf, stocky and bare-
chested. His long braided beard is thrust through his belt, and a
broad double-bladed axe hangs at his side.
Helfgrim
This tall, powerfully built man has long reddish hair and flashing
blue eyes. His ferocious demeanor is offset by his soft and calming
tone, which is more suited to a diplomat than to a weaponsmith. He
wears nicely-stitched leather clothes, and a broadsword sits nearby.
Colin
Colin is a tall, moderately-built human with short, dark, greying
hair. He appears to be near fifty years of age, but he has a
youthfulness about him which is reflected in his slate-coloured eyes.
He appears to be one who would have many tales to tell.
Skali
Skali is slim and bony, but is so well-muscled that he must not have
an ounce of fat on him. His long, lustreless brown hair is swept back
into a long ponytail, and he wears a thick leather apron. His thin
moustaches and squinting eyes give him a sinister appearance.
Gurbultis
Gurbultis is quite short, even for a gnome, but more than makes up
for this fact in pure volume. He is very fat, and wears thick violet
robes and golden chains and rings of all sizes and types, so that he
jangles with each movement. He has a sullen, brooding look.
Lady Sentara
The Lady Sentara is well-known as the most beautiful woman in
Silvermere. Though she must be nearing her fortieth year, she looks
barely older than half that. Her platinum-blonde hair, sea-blue eyes
and girlish figure have made many a man beg her hand in marriage.
dark cultist
This black-robed figure is completely shrouded, so that you cannot
see even the smallest feature. It could be nearly any humanoid
creature. A black iron pendant in the shape of a five-pointed star
hangs around its neck, and it wields a curved shortsword.
grey spider
This disgusting grey spider is huge, at least four feet long, and has
long hairy legs. Its cluster of eyes glitter malevolently, and it
scuttles around with blinding speed.
mummy
This seven foot tall humanoid monstrosity is completely shrouded in
filthy, yellowed burial wrappings. Its every movement is made with
slow deliberation, and it reeks of decay and tomb rot, forcing you to
turn your head to avoid the fumes.
bounty hunter
This man is garbed in well-worn chainmail, and a broad sword hangs on
his back. His skin is tanned and rough, and covered in many small
scars. He appears experienced and when he looks you up and down, you
get the impression that he is evaluating you abilities.
dark cleric
The figure standing before you is clad in enameled black chainmail,
and wears a hooded mask so that you cannot see its face. It wields a
spiked morning-star, and carries a large shield with a hideous horned
skull emblazoned on it. It moves without uttering a sound.
dark priest
This black-shrouded figure stares at you with unmistakeable
intensity. It wields a spiked mace which it waves about menacingly,
and it makes arcane gestures with its free hand.
dark paladin
This tall, imposing figure is entirely clad in glittering black
chainmail. It wields a heavy broadsword and a black shield emblazoned
with a red horned skull. It stands with the practiced grace of a
competent warrior, and is likely to be a tough opponent.
hellhound
This nightmarish creature looks at first glance to be a huge wolf
with greasy black fur. It is hideously misshapen, however, having
glowing crimson eyes and unnaturally large fangs. It wears a spiked
iron collar around its neck, in some sort of parody of domesticity.
tentacled abomination
This disgusting beast looks like nothing you have ever seen before.
Its lumpy, scaly hide is a green so dark it is almost black. It walks
on four webbed legs, and is covered in a dozen spiky tentacles. It
has a powerful finned tail which it waves about menacingly.
Guildmaster
This large, plain-looking man is garbed in fine clothing. His
features are thick and solid, as if he were made of stone. He looks
like a very sober man, but not unkind, and his eyes twinkle with a
light that belies his age.
old man
This wizened man sits here on a carved wooden bench. He wears faded
grey robes with what appear to have once been symbols on them. His
gaze wanders around vaguely, but as you turn to look away you think
you seem him appraise you shrewdly out of the corner of his eye.
Sheriff Lionheart
Silvermere's sheriff is an imposing figure -- six and a half feet of
pure muscle, he wears the crest of a lion on his chest, standing for
honor and truth. Icy blue eyes gaze from a face instilled with
vigilance and dedication to duty and justice.
Giovanni
This tall, slim young man is dressed in tight, brightly coloured
clothing, and sports large golden hoops in his ears. He is quite
handsome, and his brilliant smile is almost disarming. He has an air
of almost exaggerated casualness about him.
Meia
This delicate-looking woman has large, almond-shaped brown eyes and
long black hair down to her waist. She is quite young, and is as
beautiful as a fresh new flower. She bows slightly at your gaze, and
turns away, blushing.
Sarkhee
Before you stands perhaps the handsomest goblin you have ever seen.
He wears embroidered red robes and a multitude of golden bracelets,
and his wiry black hair is slicked back. A pair of delicate
spectacles is perched on the end of his nose.
bishop
This tall, well-built man is clad in sandals and the simple white
robe of his order. A large silver amulet hangs from around his neck
as some sort of symbol of office. He has dark blue eyes, greying hair
and the large rough hands of a farmer, and he smiles at you warmly.
priest
This thin, handsome young man has dark curly hair down to his
shoulders, and clear blue eyes. He wears white robes and soft shoes,
and stares at your with a serious gaze.
healer
This tall, solidly-built woman has bright green eyes and long blonde
hair which is plaited into one long braid hanging over her left
shoulder. She wears the same long white robes as her brethren, with
the difference that her sleeves are rolled up to her elbows.
dark goblin archer
This sneaky-looking goblin has dusky grey skin and is clad in black
leather armour. It wields a short bow, and a shortsword swings by its
side.
bandit
This sleazy-looking brigand wears studded leather armour, and wields
a broadsword as if he knows how to use it. He eyes you shiftily and
approaches with a sneer.
wild dog
This filthy dog reeks quite badly, and shakes as if having a seizure.
It has a crazy look in its eyes, and foams profusely at the mouth.
forest spider
This large brown spider has a small body and powerful head and jaws.
Its underbody is striped with white, and its two front legs are quite
short and have gripping claws.
giant spider
This huge, revolting spider is quite hairy and is as black as jet.
Its cluster of faintly glowing eyes seems to mock you, and it moves
with deceptive slowness. You notice something shimmering on one of
its large fangs.
dark goblin
This sly goblin has dusky grey skin and luminescent red eyes. He
wears black chainmail armour and wields a cruel-looking morningstar.
He leers evilly at you and chuckles.
kobold slave
This pathetic-looking kobold is clad in nothing but filthy rags, and
wields a small knife.
black orc
This tall, menacing-looking orc stands with uncharacteristic
discipline. He wears black chainmail armour, and wields a heavy
sword.
dire wolf
This huge wolf stands nearly four feet in height, and is covered in
a glossy grey pelt. Its red eyes glare at you visciously, and it
bares its fangs and grows spitefully.
slime beast
This large amorphous mass of slime is brownish-black in colour, and
oozes about disturbingly. Bits of unidentifiable objects poke out of
it occasionally.
half-ogre warrior
This huge half-ogre wears brigandine armour, and wields a massive
maul as if it were a light club. It grins at you stupidly from
beneath its helm.
Thrag
This huge, fifteen foot tall giant is garbed in the thick hides of
woodland animals, and wields a massive dark club in one hand. You spy
a golden sparkle from under his clothes. He sneers at you
contemptuously, hefts his club, and utters a bellowing cry!

minotaur champion
This hideous, ten foot tall beast has the head and legs of a massive
black bull, and the body of an incredibly muscled man. He wields a
huge, bone-hafted greataxe with a heavy, single-edged blade. He leers
at you evilly, and his squinting red eyes are only filled with hate.
boatman
This gnarled, weaselly-looking man has stringy gray hair and watery
green eyes. He is garbed in a shapeless robe that once might have
been a shade of blue, and his bony, calloused feet are bare and
tanned. He grins at you with an insane, lop-sided leer.
crippled adventurer
This middle-aged man has a grizzled brown beard, only just beginning
to turn grey. He is missing his left leg, and walks with the aid of
a crutch. His right arm is withered and is swathed in bandages, and
one eye is simply a mass of scars. He moves as though in great pain.
gigantic black ooze
This horiffic, immense blob nearly fills up the entire corridor. It
ripples along without making a sound. Its incredible bulk sends a
stab of fear into your heart, and you are uncertain whether or not
any mere mortal could stop its inexorable flow.
death dog
This appears to be an ordinary, if somewhat large, reddish-brown
mastiff. As you look closer though, you see that it has no eyes, just
bony hollows. It seems to move around using only its sense of smell,
as it sniffs about continually.
skeletal warrior
This tall, mail-armoured figure walks rigidly erect. A long
broadsword hangs from its waist, and it carries a round shield in its
left hand. Twin points of light glow from within its polished iron
helm like burning fires.
moaning spirit
All you can see of this strange apparition is a swirling, misty
shape somewhat like smoke. It moans ominously, making the hair stand
up on the back of your neck.
huge tiger beetle
This insectile mutation is about four feet long, and has a striped
carapace and six jointed legs. Two large, multifaceted eyes are
placed alongside its enormous mandibles. Insects of unnatural size
are known for their incredible strength and speed.
guardian golem
This appears to be a tall, heroically-proportioned stone sculpture of
a man-like creature. Its rough, chiseled features are set in a fierce
scowl. You see a slight gleam of something deeply imbedded beneath
the stone surface of its chest.
chest
This appears to be a large, ordinary-looking wooden chest. It is
bound with iron bands, and sits upon four short steel feet.
warlock mercenary
This tall, well-built man wears rigid leather armour, and a curved
sword hangs by his side. He looks confident, and if his hard,
calculating gaze is anything to go by, this confidence is well-
founded.
giant bat
This enormous bat has a six-foot wingspan, and is covered in short
black fur. Its beady eyes peer at you hungrily as it flaps towards
you!
gelatinous cube
What appears to be a ten foot cube of quivering protoplasm is before
you. It oozes forward at a respectable pace, and suspended within its
transparent core are various objects it apparently could not digest.
healer
This short man stares at you with a somewhat brooding look, with dark
eyes set deeply in his skull. He sports a small black beard, and is
quite stocky in build. The white robes he wears clearly show him to
be a healer.
Nathaniel
This tall, stocky man greets you with a welcoming smile. He has a
lined, careworn face and sports drooping moustaches that hang down
past his chin. He gestures towards his array of weaponry with a
sweeping motion.
Betram
This portly, smiling fellow greets you with a good-natured, booming
welcome. He gestures broadly towards his wares, encouraging you to
browse the merchandise.
Dathalar
This tall, handsome man has long black hair down to the middle of his
back, and wears bright red clothes that immediately catch your eye.
Rayth
This gnarled old man has seen so much sun that he is as brown as a
nut. His frazzled white hair sticks up at all angles, and his faded
grey robes are covered in obscure sigils and runes. He looks up
sharply as you approach, but then breaks into a large grin.
Corwyn
Before you stands a fine example of a fighting man. He is well-
muscled and stands with the relaxed but alert posture of someone who
is used to combat. If the silence with which he moves is anything to
go by, then fighting is not all he has some knowledge of.
zombie
This decayed corpse is barely recognizable, as its undead body has
been rent by terrible claws. It moves with a stiff-legged, shambling
gait, and it carries a splintered wooden pick in its hand. This is
obviously the restless corpse of one of the slain miners.
cave bear
This huge, menacing bear seems to be more demon than beast. Its red
eyes glare at you malevolently, and it roars a challenge as it
approaches. Its sharp curved claws appear to be able to part stone
as easily as flesh.
ferryman
This wiry, scruffy-looking man sits with his legs dangling over the
edge of the dock, a fishing pole in one hand. He nods curtly to you
as you approach.
troll
This hideous beast looks like something out of your worst nightmare.
It is a humanoid monstrosity, a perversion of nature verified by its
foot-long claws and serrated teeth. Red eyes peer at you from a thin,
grey-skinned face, and it flexes its ropy muscles in preparation.
warrior spirit
Before you stands the shimmering figure of a kang warrior, armoured
in glittering plate mail. Twin broadswords hang from his back, and
as you look him up and down, he bows slightly. With a shock, you
recognize him as one of the old Heroes of Silvermere!
fire lizard
This ten foot long lizard is bright red, and seems to be sheathed in
flames! Its powerful clawed legs propel it slowly towards you, and
its wide-set black eyes glitter evilly. Its tail swishes back and
forth hypnotisingly, leaving glowing trails in your mind's eye.
witchunter spirit
The image of a mammoth, mailed half-ogre floats before you. His huge
greatsword hangs from its side as if it were a one-handed blade. At
your approach, he looks you up and down with a surprisingly
intelligent gaze.
ogre
This huge figure towers nearly ten feet above the ground. It wears
heavy leather skins, and wields a massive club bound with iron. The
ogre's massive musculature makes you feel like an insect compared to
his power.
mystic spirit
This is image of a well-built half-orc, wearing nothing but a loose
pair of white pants. He stands in such a manner as to suggest that if
you blinked your eyes, he could be upon you before they opened again.
Despite his forbidding appearance, he gives you a toothy grin.
ranger spirit
Before you stands the image of a leather-clad elf, shrouded in a
cloak which makes her nearly invisible. A long blade and ash bow hang
from her back. Her long blonde hair is done up into many small braids
which cascade down her shoulders, and she looks you over cooly.
horned demon
This towering demon has brilliant yellow skin and two sharpened
sets of antlers that branch out from the sides of its head. Its
powerful arms have long, hooked claws, and its glaring black eyes
have no hint of mercy in them.
young girl
This dark-haired girl is clad in the white embroidered robes of a
temple priest, though she looks far too young to hold such a
position. Her wide blue eyes seem to hold much wisdom in them, and
more than a little secrecy.
priest spirit
Before you stands the image of a tall, white-robed man, his hair
greying with age. His bright green eyes seem to pierce through the
insubstantial haze surrounding him, and his commanding personality
gives him an almost regal demeanor.
cleric spirit
The image of a short, stocky dwarf clad in shining mail and bearing
a massive warhammer stands before you. The dwarf's fierce grin can
be seen through his winged helm, and as you approach he raises a
mailed fist in greeting.
paladin spirit
A shimmering image of a tall man wearing full plate armour stands
before you. He rests his hands on the pommel of his great sword, and
though you cannot see his face through his visored helm, he seems to
exude an aura of quiet sorrow.
missionary spirit
An image of a lithe human woman stands before you. She is clad in
dark leather armour, and wields a peculiar curved blade. Her shoulder
length red hair flutters like a cloud around her, and her clear grey
eyes hold your unwaveringly.
owlbear
This huge, ponderous creature appears to be some sort of cross
between a bear and a bird -- it has a massive, furred body, and the
head and beak of an oversized owl. Although it looks extremely
powerful, it does not appear too quick or perceptive.
ninja spirit
Before you stands a tall, lean half-orc, wearing full black ninja
armour. Twin short swords swing by his side, and his hood is pulled
low over his eyes. Despite his unsettling appearance, he manages a
short bow at your approach, and motions you closer.
thief spirit
The image of a halfling wavers before you. He wears soft leather
clothing, and a shortsword swings by his side. As you approach, he
grins and gives a little bow in welcoming.
bard spirit
The transparent image of a half-elven bard stands before you. She
wears bright red silks, and carries a golden harp in her hands.
fire elemental
This flickering, fiery shape holds a roughly humanoid form. It moves
about with a quiet roaring sound, and as it approaches you it reaches
out with a flaming limb to strike you.
frost serpent
This eight foot snake is completely white, save for its slitted
yellow eyes. Its black tongue flicks in and out rapidly, and it
slithers towards you.
two-headed hydra
This hideous beast is about twice the size of a large bull. Its four
scaly legs propel its heavy body forward slowly, and its two dragon-
like heads swivel around to face you. It hisses malevolently as it
methodically plods toward you.
gypsy spirit
Before you stands the image of a goblin, dressed in brightly coloured
clothes and bearing a broadsword across its back. He grins easily at
your approach, and with an elaborate flourish, bows in greeting.
warlock spirit
Before you stands the image of a gnarled, aged gnome with a long
white beard. He wears rigid battle leathers, and a short pointed
sword hangs by his side.
mage spirit
Before you stands the shadowed image of a black-shrouded dark elf.
His bright blue eyes peer from the depths of his hood, and as he
looks you up and down, he seems to nod to himself in satisfaction.
druid spirit
Before you stands the image of a grey-cloaked druid leaning upon a
nightblack staff. His piercing grey eyes seem to penetrate your mind,
and he looks as if he is evaluating you as the merchants examine
livestock.
Aldreth
The man standing before you appears to be nearly ageless -- at least,
his greying hair means he is in his middle years, but he has the
build and supple grace of a warrior of half that age. There is a
penetrating intelligence in his eyes that unsettles you.
roc hatchling
This small three foot tall bird appears to be freshly hatched, as it
still has its eyes closed. It is small, and quite awkward, yet its
beak appears to be razor sharp.

ice sorceress
This beautiful, but menacing woman appears to be made of ice. She
moves gracefully, and he violet robes flutter gently over her almost
perfect figure. In her right hand she clutches a sceptre made of a
dark blue glass, which she handles with great care.

stone golem
This is a tall, grey statue of a powerfully-built man. It swings its
fists as if they were hammers, slowly but with deadly force. Its
rocky hide makes it a tough opponent.

minotaur
This hideous, nine foot tall beast has the head and legs of a massive
black bull, and the body of an incredibly muscled man. He wields a
double-bladed battleaxe, and grins at you evilly.
giant snake
This long, mottled serpent is perhaps twenty feet in length. Its
grey-green hide is thick and lumpy, its head arrow-shaped and blunt.
The snake peers at you maliciously with its evil yellow eyes, and
slithers towards you.
banshee
This misty appararition appears to be a white-robed woman, her face
hidden by a dark hood. Her translucent form seems to radiate power,
and a chill of fear runs up your spine.
minotaur chieftain
This hideous, ten foot tall beast has the head and legs of a massive
black bull, and the body of an incredibly muscled man. He wields a
huge, glittering black battleaxe, and is adorned with tattoos and
all sorts of primitive jewelry.
vampire rosebush
This large, spiny bush is covered in the most delicate, beautiful
red roses you have ever seen. The leaves are a deep, glossy green,
and the stems are unusually long and supple. The plant seems to
quiver at your approach.
archer bush
This dense, woody bush grows close to the ground. Its thick, squat
trunk sprouts many branches studded with wicked-looking thorns.
animated tree
This tall, twisted darkwood tree looms ominously over you. Its deep
green foliage is covered in a creeping yellow rot, and its bark is
peeling and diseased. It has been animated by some unknown force, and
moves about on thick roots, slowly but with great power.
carnivorous plant
This large, spiny plant has many broad jagged-edged leaves. Its thick
stem supports a bulbous head filled with inward-curving teeth. Dozens
of tendrils sprouting from its base move it about, and wave
menacingly.
wood golem
This is a twisted wooden construction in the rough shape of a human.
It stands about seven feet high, and moves with a jerky, awkward
gait. Its heavy arms could cause considerable damage in combat.
earth elemental
This massive, lumpish creature is formed out of the very earth you
walk on. Sticks and twigs poke out of its body, and it is riddled
with stones. It moves slowly, but has the fearsome power of the
elemental plane of earth at its command.
dark druid
This mysterious, cowled figure wears a robe of dark gray embellished
with black runes. Glittering eyes peer at you maliciously from the
depths of its hood, and it wields a twisted oaken staff as if it
knows how to use it.
high druid
This tall, dark figure is garbed in a robe of deep grey, with silvery
runes around the cuffs and hem. A long white beard flows from the
depths of the hood, and glittering eyes peer at you evilly. The high
druid holds a wicked-looking golden sickle with a shimmering edge.

black orc captain
This tall, powerfully built orc has jet black skin and glowing red
eyes. He wears glittering black chainmail, and wields a heavy
scimitar. His evil grin exposes his sharp yellow fangs.
black orc shaman
This brutal-looking figure is garbed in a rough brown robe. Glowing
red eyes peer at you from the depths of its hood, and it waves its
clawed hands about in mystical patterns. An evil aura emanates from
this creature.
dark goblin warlock
This evil-looking goblin has dusky grey skin and luminescent red
eyes. He wears shiny black hide armour, and wields a long curved
sword. His pointy white teeth are bared in an evil grin as he
advances towards you.
slave-master
This tall, heavily muscled man wears gaudy, mismatched armour, more
for show than for effectiveness. His face and head are hidden by a
heavy iron helm, with a slit for the eyes and metal grilles over the
ears and mouth. He wields a large, wicked-looking barbed scourge.
werewolf
This lithe, well-built figure is completely covered in shaggy,
reddish hair. Its long arms sport wicked-looking curved claws. A
heavy helm crafted in the shape of a wolf's head conceals its facial
features, but the glint of red eyes and shining fangs can be seen.
shadowy healer
This mysterious figure is garbed in plain, midnight-black robes. At
your approach, it beckons to you softly.
mad wizard

cold eyes seem to hunger for your soul.
amazon shopkeeper
This cowering shopkeeper is obviously in fear of his life. As you
approach, he fauns over you, displaying his best wares prominently.
He is quite a pathetic person, and you might have felt sorry for him
if he wasn't such a piece of worthless scum.
dying master assassin
This once graceful woman is now a disheveled heap of tattered cloth
and blood. Her breathing is very shallow and you can tell she is
about to be visited by the Reaper himself.
stronghold guard
This grim-looking figure is garbed in worn leather armour, and a
long scimitar hangs in a sheath at his side. On constant alert for
Saracen raiders, he is very suspicious of outsiders.
massive ice dragon
This gigantic, white-scaled lizard is nearly seventy-five feet from
its icy snout to its frigid tail. Its frosty blue eyes stare at you
in pure malevolence. You see parts of its body covered in thick
sheets of ice.
carriage headmaster
A picture of elegance, this man is dressed in the finest cloth, and
even wears a finely tailored wig. Bright blue eyes gaze at you with
some haughtiness, but he still bows awaiting your request for
service.
carriage headmaster
This man reeks of sweat and horse manure. Its obvious he hasn't
shaved in weeks, and when he smiles he has more teeth missing then
you've seen on any other humanoid. His black eye almost leers at you.
carriage headmaster
Plain brown clothing goes with the dull brown hair of this homely
man. He looks at you with indifference and almost impatience. You
guess he wishes to be doing something else, but all the same he will
stand here for a fair wage.
lady of the dark
Wearing a large crown of utter blackness you see a figure that is
darker then the blackest night sky. Two eyes, as white as a new star
gaze at you. All light around you is absorbed by this malevolent
being and elongated claws weave in mythical patterns.
orc warrior
This tall, muscular orc is garbed in a well-maintained suit of
chainmail, and glares at you through the eyeslits of a steel helm. He
wields a wickedly-curved scimitar, and wields it with deadly
competence.
orc fanatic
Garbed in a sleevless leather tunic, runic tattoos play across the
orc's well muscled arms. A wicked looking halberd made of the orcish
black steel moves fluidly back and forth in the beasts hands with the
quickness of a weapon half its size.
orc trainee
Wearing a tattered suit of chainmail, bruises and cuts show that this
orc has been greatly abused. Looking to prove themselves in a fight
and get the title of Warrior, this orc is looking to do battle.
Enigma Lord
A man wrapped in a puzzle, dressed in a riddle.

frost giant
This huge man stands twenty feet tall, with an extra five feet added
due to his massive helm which scrapes against the ceiling. His snow
white skin is tinged only by his bushy blue eyebrows and ice blue
beard. His eyes look down at you, and bellows in outrage.
elite guardsman
This is a massive burly man wearing gleaming platemail that shines
brightly as if freshly polished. He wields a massive platinum
greatsword with incredible ease, and you can only assume to be
the guardsman he must have cast knowledge to use it too.
skeleton
The animated skeleton of a humanoid creature stands before you. Bits
of dried flesh cling to its yellow bones, and faint flickers of red
light can be seen in its eye sockets. The undead are known to be very
difficult to destroy, as they are already dead.
zombie
This is an animated, rotting corpse. It walks around listlessly, and
its eyeless face gives no hint of emotion. The necromantic magic that
has animated this creation has made it quite tough to slay, and it is
imbued with an unnatural strength.
shade
This is a shadowy spirit in the vague shape of a human, with glowing
red points of light where its eyes should be. It is hard to see, and
seems to fade in and out of existance.
ghoul
This awful-looking creature appears to be a filthy, emaciated human -
until you see its glowing red eyes and sharp claws. Its frail
appearance belies powerful muscles, and it moves with surprising
grace.
wight
This revolting undead creation is a bent, misshapen humanoid with
glowing red points for eyes, and cruelly-hooked claws. Despite its
gaunt appearance, you can see it is powerfully muscled, and moves
with the confident speed of a cat.
skeletal warrior
This tall, mail-armoured figure walks rigidly erect. A long
broadsword hangs from its waist, and it carries a round shield in its
left hand. Twin points of light glow from within its polished iron
helm like burning fires.
moaning spirit
All you can see of this strange apparition is a swirling, misty
shape somewhat like smoke. It moans ominously, making the hair stand
up on the back of your neck.
banshee
This misty appararition appears to be a white-robed woman, her face
hidden by a dark hood. Her translucent form seems to radiate power,
and a chill of fear runs up your spine.
ghost
This nearly transparent apparition moans softly as it floats about.
It clutches its torn white funeral rags closely to itself. Although
it appears sad and lonely, the undead are known to vent their rage
and frustration upon the living.
shadowraith
This unnerving apparition seems to be your worst nightmare-- a large
shadowy figure with long, wicked claws and hellishly burning eyes. It
moves with an unnatural grace as it stalks you!
barrow wight
This frightening apparition is completely garbed in what appear to be
gilded ceremonial robes, the kind that nobles and heros are buried
in. In one withered hand it wields a long, glittering silvery dagger,
and twin points of red light glow from beneath its darkened hood!
zombie cat
This stiff, undead cat is surprisingly large, and moves with somewhat
less grace than it did in life. Being dead has its advantages,
however, and the zombie cat is both vastly stronger and tougher than
any mortal cat.
undead priest
This eternally rotting corpse is animated by some evil, unnatural
force. Once a high-ranking priest of the Dark One, it now serves him
in death, retaining its unholy powers even after death. It has no
mercy for the living.
tortured spirit
This spirit appears as a glowing, translucent humanlike shape, whose
form shifts and wavers like a desert mirage. It moans in agony and
despair, living even in death and prevented from eternal rest.
ju-ju zombie
This is an animated, rotting corpse. It walks around listlessly, and
its eyeless face gives no hint of emotion. The necromantic magic that
has animated this creation has made it quite tough to slay, and it is
imbued with an unnatural strength.
necromancer
Ragged black robes are wrapped around the skeletally-thin form of the
necromancer. Not quite dead but certainly not living, he exists
between the realm of life and death, and drains the souls from all
those he meets.
giant skeleton
An unfortunate trainee that fell victim to the caverns, it now has a
hatred for all that is living. It towers before you, its maniacal
grin lighted by the magic flame inside its rib-cage seems like a
heart of magma, it shouts a ghostly roar as it steps foward!
bone warrior
A dull green glow emanates from the eye sockets of this long since
dead warrior. No flesh appears upon the undead to show the scars of
battles past. Deep gouges in some of the bones surrounding vital
areas are evidence that their death was not timely.
filthy beggar
This filthy wretch appears gaunt and incredibly dirty. You can are
almost overcome by the smell of sweat and rubbish that covers this
person clothed only in rags and burlap. A single dirty hand reachs up
to you asking for money.
depraved murderer
With a crazed look in his bloodshot eyes this man looks at you with
a hunger that turns your stomach, he wields an evil looking knife
made of bone, and the blood of his victims is stained on his smock.
With cold yet chaotic precision he begins to advance on you.
mangy dog
You almost gag from the smell that rises from the fur of this filthy
mutt. He glances at you once barring his teeth, and then begins to
clean his nether regions.
dread planewalker
All you can see of this nightmarish creature is a faint outline of
talons and fangs, and blood red reptilian eyes. A cold wind seems to
blow in from some where and it lets out a howl of a thousand shrieks
giving you chills to the point of convulsion.
townsman
A simple townsman dressed in plain leathers and an old dusty hat he
appears to be in thought about his task at hand or ahead of him, he
glances up at you from his reverie and smiles before continuing on.
drunken brawler
This obviously plastered person staggers aimlessly about, an empty
pewter tankard in one hand, and a link of sausages in the other. He
is quite angry, probably at being thrown out of every bar in town,
and is picking fights with everyone he meets.
townswoman
Almost as plain as the simple dress she wears this lady looks to be
going to or from a destination, she stops briefly to curtsey to you
before continuing on.
squirrel
This chittery litte forest creature prances around looking for food,
he keeps an eye on you all times as he forages for food, ready to
spring at any moment.
Mayor Godfrey
This middle-aged man has salt and peppered hair and sports a small
goatee. Dressed in fine silks he walks around with a proud air of
any elected official. Despite this he is very jovial looking and you
can't help but like him. Around his neck is the town seal.
troll
This hideous beast looks like something out of your worst nightmare.
It is a humanoid monstrosity, a perversion of nature verified by its
foot-long claws and serrated teeth. Red eyes peer at you from a thin,
grey-skinned face, and it flexes its ropy muscles in preparation.
black cat
This sleek black feline has a natural elegance about it as it brushes
up against your leg. It purrs softly before moving on in search of
food. You chuckle at an old superstition wondering how any creature
like this could cause harm to someone.
mercenary healer
This figure has goes door to door selling his healing powers for the
all powerful gold crown. Grabed in simple grey robes he sits in the
middle of the floor awaiting your request.
mangy dog
You almost gag from the smell that rises from the fur of this filthy
mutt. He glances at you once barring his teeth, and then begins to
clean his nether regions.
young gypsy girl
Looking at this young girl you would guess her age was preteen except
for an ancient wisdom that seems to lie in her hazel eyes. She sits
before an ancient red card table, placing cards from a deck in her
hand onto the table. You wonder what luck may lay in those cards.
gravedigger
The gravedigger of Silvermere appears to be a man in his late forty's
with dirty grey hair and a gaunt look on his face. You can tell he
hasn't slept in days and he has a nervous twitch on his left cheek.
His bloodshot eyes look up at you and he says nothing.
This giant birdlike creature resembles a huge two headed buzzard,
aside from its white downy feathers. It has a twenty foot wingspan,
and its enormous claws hold razor sharp talons.
giant roc
This titanic creature ressembles a vulture, but of an incredible
size. Its wingspan must be at least a hundred feet wide, its beak as
long as a canoe and razor-sharp. Each talon is as long as a human is
tall. Luckily it is huge enough that it ignores most small folk.
